```{r}
library(jsonlite)
```
```{r}
Laag_Inkomen <- read.csv("Lage Inkomens.csv", sep = ";")
```
```{r}
 Bevolking <- read.csv("Bevolking.csv", sep = ";")

```
```{r}
# Merge Laag_Inkomen met Bevolking op RegioS en Perioden
Laag_Inkomen_merged <- merge(
  Laag_Inkomen,
  Bevolking[, c("RegioS", "Perioden", "BevolkingOp1Januari_1")],
  by = c("RegioS", "Perioden"),
  all.x = TRUE  # Zorgt dat alle rijen van Laag_Inkomen behouden blijven
)

```


```{r}
library(dplyr)

Laag_Inkomen_merged <- Laag_Inkomen_merged %>%
  mutate(Totaal_werkende_armen = (Personen_2 / 1000) * BevolkingOp1Januari_1)
#rounding
Laag_Inkomen_merged <- Laag_Inkomen_merged %>%
  mutate(Totaal_werkende_armen = round(Totaal_werkende_armen))

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)

Laag_Inkomen_merged <- Laag_Inkomen_merged %>%
  mutate(
    working_poor = Totaal_werkende_armen / BevolkingOp1Januari_1
  )
#Afronding percentage
Laag_Inkomen_merged <- Laag_Inkomen_merged %>%
  mutate(
    working_poor = round((Totaal_werkende_armen / BevolkingOp1Januari_1) * 100, 1)
  )



```
```{r}
# Create a named vector for mapping RegioS codes to city names
city_map <- c(
  "GM0268" = "Nijmegen",
  "GM0307" = "Amersfoort",
  "GM0344" = "Utrecht",
  "GM0363" = "Amsterdam",
  "GM0392" = "Haarlem",
  "GM0523" = "Hardinxveld-Giessendam",
  "GM0534" = "Hillegom",
  "GM0599" = "Rotterdam",
  "GM0532" = "Stede Broec"
)

# Add the new City column by matching RegioS values
Laag_Inkomen_merged$City <- city_map[Laag_Inkomen_merged$RegioS]

```
```{r}
#Delete useless columns
Laag_Inkomen_merged <- Laag_Inkomen_merged[, !(names(Laag_Inkomen_merged) %in% c("InkomensgrensHuishouden", "DuurInkomenspositie", "KenmerkenVanHuishoudens"))]



```
```{r}
# Define vectors for each city type
big_cities <- c("Amsterdam", "Rotterdam", "Utrecht")
medium_cities <- c("Amersfoort", "Nijmegen", "Haarlem")
small_cities <- c("Hardinxveld-Giessendam", "Hillegom", "Stede Broec")

# Create the new column using ifelse
Laag_Inkomen_merged$Type_of_city <- ifelse(
  Laag_Inkomen_merged$City %in% big_cities, "big",
  ifelse(
    Laag_Inkomen_merged$City %in% medium_cities, "medium",
    ifelse(
      Laag_Inkomen_merged$City %in% small_cities, "small",
      NA  # for any city not in the lists
    )
  )
)

```
```{r}
Laag_Inkomen_merged$Covid <- ifelse(
  Laag_Inkomen_merged$Perioden %in% c("2018JJ00", "2019JJ00"), "Pre-Covid",
  ifelse(
    Laag_Inkomen_merged$Perioden %in% c("2022JJ00", "2023JJ00"), "Post-Covid",
    NA  # For any other years or missing values
  )
)

```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Explicitly set factor levels to include all city types
Laag_Inkomen_merged$Type_of_city <- factor(
  Laag_Inkomen_merged$Type_of_city,
  levels = c("small", "medium", "big")
)

# Create the boxplot, forcing all levels to appear on the x-axis
ggplot(Laag_Inkomen_merged, aes(x = Type_of_city, y = working_poor)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "skyblue", color = "darkblue", show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +  # important: do not drop unused factor levels
  labs(
    title = "Working poor percentage by City Type",
    x = "Type of City",
    y = "Working poor percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()




```
```{r}
# Set the factor levels so Pre-Covid comes first, Post-Covid second
Laag_Inkomen_merged$Covid <- factor(Laag_Inkomen_merged$Covid, levels = c("Pre-Covid", "Post-Covid"))

library(ggplot2)

# Create the plot with the reordered factor
ggplot(Laag_Inkomen_merged, aes(x = Covid, y = working_poor, fill = Covid)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Type_of_city) +
  labs(
    title = "Working poor percentage Before and After Covid by City Type",
    x = "Covid Period",
    y = "Working poor percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()




```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Define the big cities you want to focus on
big_cities <- c("Amsterdam", "Utrecht", "Rotterdam")

# Filter the dataframe for big cities only
Laag_Inkomen_filtered <- Laag_Inkomen_merged %>%
  filter(Type_of_city == "big" & City %in% big_cities)

# Ensure Covid factor levels are ordered correctly
Laag_Inkomen_filtered$Covid <- factor(Laag_Inkomen_filtered$Covid, levels = c("Pre-Covid", "Post-Covid"))

# Create the boxplot faceted by City
ggplot(Laag_Inkomen_filtered, aes(x = Covid, y = working_poor, fill = Covid)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ City) +
  labs(
    title = "Working Poor percentage Before and After Covid in Big Cities",
    x = "Covid Period",
    y = "Working Poor percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Pre-Covid" = "blue", "Post-Covid" = "red"))

```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Define the big cities you want to focus on
big_cities <- c("Amsterdam", "Utrecht", "Rotterdam")

# Filter the dataframe for only these big cities
Laag_Inkomen_filtered_no_time <- Laag_Inkomen_merged %>%
  filter(City %in% big_cities)

# Create the boxplot, grouping by City, without splitting by Covid period
ggplot(Laag_Inkomen_filtered_no_time, aes(x = City, y = working_poor, fill = City)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Overall Working poor percentage Distribution in Big Cities",
    subtitle = "(Aggregated Pre- & Post-Covid Data)",
    x = "City",
    y = "Working poor percentage"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") # Hide legend as fill is just for city

```
```{r}

library(sf)
gpkg_path <- "cbsgebiedsindelingen2025.gpkg"
gemeente_gegeneraliseerd <- st_read(gpkg_path, layer = "gemeente_gegeneraliseerd")


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
merged_spatial <- gemeente_gegeneraliseerd %>%
  left_join(Laag_Inkomen_merged, by = c("statnaam" = "City"))
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(merged_spatial) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = working_poor), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue", na.value = "grey90") +
  labs(
    title = "Zoomed-In Spatial Distribution of Working Poor percentage",
    fill = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(50000, 200000),  
    ylim = c(420000, 500000)   
  )

```
```{r}
# Load necessary library
library(ggplot2)

# Convert 'Perioden' to year by extracting the first four characters
Laag_Inkomen_merged$Year <- as.numeric(substr(Laag_Inkomen_merged$Perioden, 1, 4))

# Group by 'Year' and sum the 'Totaal_werkende_armen' for each year
df_yearly <- aggregate(Totaal_werkende_armen ~ Year, data = Laag_Inkomen_merged, sum)

# Plot the line graph
ggplot(df_yearly, aes(x = Year, y = Totaal_werkende_armen)) +
  geom_line(color = 'blue', size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = 'red', size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Total Working Poor by Year", x = "Year", y = "Total Working Poor") +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
# Load necessary library
library(ggplot2)

# Convert 'Perioden' to year by extracting the first four characters
Laag_Inkomen_merged$Year <- as.numeric(substr(Laag_Inkomen_merged$Perioden, 1, 4))

# Group by 'Year' and calculate the mean of 'werkende_armen_per_capita' for each year
df_yearly_percentage <- aggregate(working_poor ~ Year, data = Laag_Inkomen_merged, mean)

# Plot the line graph
ggplot(df_yearly_percentage, aes(x = Year, y = working_poor)) +
  geom_line(color = 'blue', size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = 'red', size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Total Percentage of Working Poor by Year", x = "Year", y = "Percentage of Working Poor") +
  theme_minimal()


```
